Mumbai weather update: IMD predicts 36 degrees Celsius on Sunday as yellow alert covers Mumbai and Thane
Colaba's maximum was 0.5 degrees above normal, while Santacruz recorded a temperature within the normal range. Night temperatures also remained relatively warm, with Colaba recording a minimum of 26.4 degrees Celsius, 1.7 degrees above normal, and Santacruz registering 24.3 degrees Celsius, 1.3 degrees above normal
The maximum and minimum temperatures are likely to hover around 36 degrees Celsius and 26 degrees Celsius, respectively. (File Pic/ Ashish Raje)
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a yellow alert for Mumbai, Thane, Palghar and Raigad, warning of hot and humid conditions in isolated areas on Sunday.
Mumbai is expected to experience mainly clear skies, with hot and humid conditions likely to persist in parts of the city and its suburbs.
